Q: How can an OCR confidence score lead to an incorrect but well-cited answer?
spoken: OCR confidence concerns an extraction process and is not a calibrated probability that a business claim is correct. Verify layout, reading order, tables, units and critical characters against source pages. Preserve locations and route uncertain fields for review. A cited extraction error remains an error even if later retrieval and generation follow it faithfully.
